result.justification: The study provides a clear objective to examine the recognition of SARS-CoV-2 variants by antibodies and their pathogenesis in an animal model, with detailed methodology outlined for experiments.

evidence.quote: The present study describes two phenotypically distinct variants of SARS-CoV-2, differing by a mutation in the region of the genome encoding the NTD of the spike protein...
Viral RNA was isolated from the culture supernatant using the Extract RNA reagent (Eurogen, Moscow, Russia) followed by chloroform extraction.
Syrian hamsters were used as a non-lethal animal model to assess the pathogenic properties of the Delta SARS-CoV-2 variants upon intranasal infection.
